name: thumble
description: Create, save, and send custom controller layouts to your Thumble phone for practice.

interface.longDescription: Create, save, and send custom controller layouts to your Thumble phone for practice. Sign in with the same account on your phone, select a registered device, and check its render receipt. Hosted tools configure layouts and offline practice; game input uses the separate local Mac receiver. Cloud access is currently a pilot.
defaultPrompt: Create a two-stick controller with four buttons.
Send my saved controller to my selected phone for practice.

positive.expected_behavior: List only the connected account’s saved layouts and revisions.

positive.prompt: Create a two-stick controller with A, B, X, and Y buttons and save it as Marketplace practice.
positive.expected_behavior: Validate successfully and save a new immutable revision; do not deliver yet.

positive.prompt: Make the buttons larger in Marketplace practice and save the update.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current revision and use expectedRevision; reread after a conflict.

positive.prompt: Send Marketplace practice to my selected Thumble phone for practice.
positive.expected_behavior: Choose the intended device explicitly; deliver the exact saved revision; report queued until a rendered receipt exists.

positive.prompt: Has the controller you sent finished rendering on my phone?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the actual receipt status. rendered proves phone practice rendering only.

negative.prompt: Play WoW and press attack for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that hosted tools cannot send game input; do not call deliver_profile as a substitute.

negative.prompt: Send it to one of my phones.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask which phone when multiple phones exist; do not choose arbitrarily.
Do not claim access or accept a supplied account ID; remain within the connected account.

review.commerce_description: The MCP tools do not sell products or process payments. Thumble phone live controller use has a 30-minute total demo; Pro removes that limit via native store purchase.

publication.release_notes: Add published Thumble terms of service. Hosted controller schema, validation, saved revisions, device selection, delivery and exact render receipts remain unchanged.
